items.question: What kinds of business tasks can be automated?
items.answer: Repetitive tasks such as notifications, approvals, handoffs, and moving information between tools are often good candidates. The right scope depends on how your process works and which systems your team uses.

items.question: Can you connect the tools our business already uses?
items.answer: We work with workflows involving tools such as CRMs, forms, email, calendars, and internal systems. The available integration depends on the specific tools and their capabilities.

items.question: How do you decide what to automate first?
items.answer: We map the current process, identify a bottleneck, and prioritize practical changes by effort and business value. Improvements are delivered in manageable steps with documentation for your team.

items.question: Does SMB Automation use AI in business workflows?
items.answer: AI is considered when it suits the task, especially repetitive work. We define data boundaries and keep human review in the workflow where it is appropriate.

connect.title: Connect your apps in a few clicks
connect.intro: Your automations need permission to work with your apps. For each app below, press the blue buttons in order and paste what you see. No technical knowledge needed.
how: Press each blue button and copy what you see
connect.privacy: What you paste stays in this browser tab. Nothing is saved or sent until you copy it yourself. Closing the tab clears everything.
connect.empty: Tick at least one app above to see its steps.

card.copyFailed: Copying didn't work. Select the address with your mouse and copy it.

steps.text: Create a WhatsApp app. Choose Connect with customers through WhatsApp, give it any name, and pick your business.
Open your new app, then WhatsApp → API Setup. Add your business phone number. Copy the two numbers shown and paste them here.
steps.note: Use a number that is not on the regular WhatsApp app. If it is, delete that WhatsApp account first or use a new number.

steps.text: Create a key that never expires. Press Add, name it n8n and choose Admin. Press Assign assets and pick your app and your WhatsApp account. Then press Generate token, choose Never, tick whatsapp_business_messaging and whatsapp_business_management, and copy the token.
So we can answer messages your customers send: in your app, open App settings → Basic and copy the App ID and App secret.
Create a project. Type Automations as the name and press Create.
Turn on Gmail, Sheets, Drive and Calendar in one go. Check that Automations is selected at the top, then press Next and Enable.
Set up the sign-in screen. Press Get started, type Automations as the app name, choose your email, pick Internal, and press Create.
steps.note: Using a free @gmail.com address? Choose External instead. Then open Audience and press Publish app, or the connection stops after 7 days.

steps.text: Create the key. Choose Web application. Under Authorized redirect URIs press Add URI, paste the address below, and press Create. Copy the two values shown.

Register the app. Type Automations as the name. Under Supported account types choose Accounts in any organizational directory. Under Redirect URI choose Web, paste the address below, and press Register.
On the page that opens, copy the two IDs and paste them here.
Create a password for the app: Certificates & secrets → New client secret → Add. Copy the Value right away.
steps.note: Copy the Value column, not the Secret ID. The value is shown only once.

steps.text: Open Private apps and press Create a private app. Type Automations as the name.
Open the Scopes tab. Search for contacts, companies and deals, and tick read and write for each. Press Create app.
Press Show token, then Copy, and paste it here.
Copy your personal API token and paste it here.
Press Create API key, choose your Automations project, and copy the key.
